headline: Chikipi Egg Layer
title: Chikipi | Free Eggs From Your Ranch | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need eggs for your cooking? Chikipi has you covered. Its partner skill, Egg Layer, makes it sometimes lay an Egg when you assign it to the Ranch. At base it also handles Gathering and Farming, both at level one. It is a Neutral Pal from the very start of the Paldeck, so it is cheap and easy to catch early. Do you keep Chikipi on your ranch? Comment below!
description: Chikipi in Palworld 1.0: Egg Layer drops Eggs at the Ranch, plus Gathering level one and Farming level one.
